decisions.reason: As a supporting burner component within the firm’s established radiant-heating portfolio, it remains useful for the installed base and system business, though it is somewhat less central than the firm’s newer strategic focus areas.
This electric infrared panel heater line is a clear strategic product with multiple models and strong fit to the firm’s move toward lower-carbon, integrated building-climate solutions.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater remains closely aligned with the firm’s low-carbon direction and has an early real-world reference, despite the still gradual market ramp-up for hydrogen applications.
